meaning.zh:
“勃然大怒” 或 “暴跳如雷”。

这个短语源自于一个人非常生气，情绪爆发的时候，仿佛会跳起来击中天花板。在英语中，"hit the ceiling" 常用来描述一个人突然变得非常愤怒，通常是因为某件令人烦恼或无法接受的事情。
meaning.en: This idiom originates from the image of someone jumping up and hitting the ceiling due to extreme anger. In English, "hit the ceiling" is commonly used to describe someone becoming suddenly very angry, usually because of something upsetting or unacceptable.

lines.en: When he heard the news about the mistake, he *hit the ceiling*.
lines.zh: 当他听到错误的消息时，他勃然大怒。

lines.en: She *hit the ceiling* when she found out her car was towed.
lines.zh: 当她发现她的车被拖走时，她暴跳如雷。

lines.en: My dad *hit the ceiling* when I told him I crashed the car.
lines.zh: 我告诉爸爸我撞了车时，他大为光火。
